initial-dialogue.npc: Greetings, adventurer. How can I be of service?

initial-dialogue.player: I'm not sure. What type of services do you provide?

initial-dialogue.text: If the player has not completed The Blood Moon Rises:

steps.npc: I have a client in need of... specimens. I'll happily take any grown dogs off your hands.

steps.player: What does your client use them for?

initial-dialogue.text: If the player has completed The Blood Moon Rises:

steps.npc: Father Sugadinti is in need of... specimens. I'll happily take any grown dogs off your hands.

steps.player: What does he use them for?

initial-dialogue.npc: That is not information I am privy to.
I can compensate you. A modest sum of blood runes, in exchange for each dog you bring me.
Would you like to make an exchange?

initial-dialogue.text: If the player doesn't have a dog with them:

steps.player: I'm afraid I don't have a dog to offer you.

steps.text: If the player has not completed The Blood Moon Rises:
If the player has completed The Blood Moon Rises:

initial-dialogue.text: If the player has a dog with them:

steps.player: I have a dog if you're interested.

subsequent-dialogue.npc: You've come once again, adventurer. Would you like to make an exchange?

subsequent-dialogue.text: If the player doesn't have a dog with them:

steps.player: I'm afraid I don't have a dog to offer you.

steps.text: If the player has not completed The Blood Moon Rises:
If the player has completed The Blood Moon Rises:

subsequent-dialogue.text: If the player has a dog with them:

steps.player: I have a dog if you're interested.

using-items-on-them-grown-dog.npc: An excellent specimen. I can offer you [100/200] blood runes in exchange for your [dog]?

steps.player: No, thank you. I won't be selling any dogs today.

steps.text: You exchange your [dog] for [100/200] blood runes.

steps.npc: Pleasure doing business, adventurer. Please, return if you have more to offer. Father Sugadinti will always accept such fine specimens.

using-items-on-them-regular-puppy.npc: I'm afraid I cannot take them so young. They need to be fully grown for Father Sugadinti.

using-items-on-them-hellpuppy.npc: That fiery one would be more effort than it is worth, although I appreciate the offer.

using-items-on-them-bloodhound.npc: That is a rare breed. For the deal to be fair, you would need to be compensated more blood runes than I can offer.

using-items-on-them-any-other-item.npc: I'm afraid my client is only interested in canines, although I appreciate the offer.

lRihSI.npc: Please, return when you do. My client is always in need of more specimens.
